_comment: The published-data module: data deposited in public repositories (Zenodo, figshare) - found by DOI or by words, browsed by subject, and opened inside the archives they are deposited in. Field-neutral, so it is a module of its own rather than part of any field's: free Fit and Fit Pro link it, a product with no use for published research data leaves it out (fit/tools/build-lib/product_modules.ps1).
name: published-data
